text:
Maya: Heads up — canary for inference-service (eu-west-1) spiked to ~15% 5xxs and we're seeing ~40% of canary traffic landing in eu-west-1a. Not normal distribution. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: split 10% -> 50% at 1975004300 by ArgoCD (app=inference-service, rev=canary-2026-03-18) :rotating_light:

Jonah: Can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` and node AZs?

Maya: sure, short dump:
```
$ kubectl get pods -l app=inference-service -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS    NODE                IP           
inference-canary-abc123             1/1     Running   ip-10-0-3-45      10.0.3.12
inference-canary-def456             1/1     Running   ip-10-0-3-53      10.0.3.13
inference-canary-ghi789             1/1     Running   ip-10-0-3-61      10.0.3.14
inference-stable-xyz000             1/1     Running   ip-10-0-1-12      10.0.1.5

# all canary pods on nodes in eu-west-1a (10.0.3.x)
```

Ravi: Looks like ASG scaled up 4 g4dn nodes but all landed in AZ a because scaling window/placement bias. Checking ASG events now. Can you pause the canary split?

Maya: Paused via ArgoCD UI and set split back to 10% (manual). ArgoCD-bot: rollback candidate created (app=inference-service, from=canary-2026-03-18 -> pinned=stable).

Ravi: ASG events show: "launched instance i-0abc... in eu-west-1a" x4, then AZRebalance disabled; Terraform state's desired_capacity=4 for asg.inference-pool-eu-west-1a (tf drift?). Running `terraform state show aws_autoscaling_group.inference-pool` now.

Eva: Short-term mitigations:
- keep canary paused / set split to 0-5%
- manually trigger an extra instance in eu-west-1b/c to spread pods (or scale sub-ASG for those AZs)
- add topologySpreadConstraints & podAntiAffinity on canary to avoid AZ pinning next time

Jonah: Long-term fixes we should consider:
- enable AZRebalance and ensure mixed_instances_policy with multiple subnets in TF module
- update cluster-autoscaler/ASG config to prefer even AZ distribution (scale-up across subnets)
- add scheduler constraints: topologySpreadConstraints + pod topology keys for zone
- tighten GitOps check: block canary >25% unless zone distribution >= 2 AZs available

Maya: Also noticed cluster-autoscaler has scaleDownDelay=5m default; when canary increased we hit a window where only one AZ had capacity. Maybe bump scaleDownDelay and tune the balancer.

Ravi: Quick commands I'm running now:
```
# cordon/uncordon not doing full drain on GPU nodes
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-3-45
# create an emergency node in eu-west-1b via aws cli (using same launch template)
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name asg-inference-eu-west-1b --desired-capacity 2
```

ArgoCD-bot: ArgoCD sync paused for app=inference-service by Maya at 1975004400

Maya: I'm also going to add a temporary helm value override for canary to include:
```
# values-canary.yaml (temporary)
podAntiAffinity:
  preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      podAffinityTerm:
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
```

Eva: We should also add a pre-rollout check in our pipeline (GitHub Actions / ArgoCD hook) that validates cluster AZ spread for requested canary size and rejects if <2 AZs available.

Jonah: Agreed. I'll open a small RFC: "canary-safety: validate-az-spread-before-traffic-ramp" and a quick PR to the GitOps pipeline to block >10% ramp if AZs <2.

Ravi: FYI terraform drift: someone manually patched ASG in console earlier today to accelerate capacity for a different job — that's why desired_capacity mismatched TF. I'll revert console change and force apply TF to re-enable AZ balancing.

Maya: Next actions tracked:
- Ravi: reconcile ASG + TF, enable AZRebalance (ASG), ensure asg spans multiple subnets (ETA 30m)
- Jonah: PR for pipeline AZ check (ETA 2d)
- Eva: Helm/helmfile patch for podAntiAffinity and topology constraints (quick override applied)
- Maya: monitor canary & re-run light traffic ramp once AZ spread confirmed (do not exceed 15%)

Jonah: Thanks. Adding incident note and linking to runbook (runbooks/infra/canary-az-imbalance.md) :thumbsup:

Maya: will follow up with postmortem if rollout caused customer-visible errors. For now keeping canary throttled and ASG changes in progress.

Ravi: ASG reconcile complete, launched 2 nodes in eu-west-1b, 1 in eu-west-1c. Rebalanced pods — canary now 3 AZs. Last check shows 2xxs recovering.

Maya: Great, let's do a cautious ramp after 10m stable metrics window. Leaving thread open.
